name: cache-keeper
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while a session idles: every 50 minutes (configurable) one tiny request over the conversation prefix, so the entry does not lapse after an hour

interval_minutes.title: Interval (minutes)
interval_minutes.description: How long the session may idle before a poke. The cache lapses after an hour, so this must be under 60; the mod clamps it to 5–59

max_idle_hours.title: Idle cap (hours)
max_idle_hours.description: Stop warming once this long has passed since the last real turn, so a forgotten session does not spend all night. 0 means never stop

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off means the mod sends nothing; /cache-keeper on and off only affect the current session

show_band.title: Show countdown
show_band.description: Draw the countdown and counters in the band above the prompt

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language: auto (from LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG), en, zh-TW or ja

band_style.title: Band style
band_style.description: How this mod's line above the prompt is framed: box (a rounded frame), rule (a thin line beneath), plain (text only)
